facts.summary: Users may provide feedback about PDS services, portal experience or the assistance they received through the feedback mechanism provided by the applicable PDS authority or system.
purpose: Share an experience with a PDS service.
Report problems or difficulties with a PDS portal or service.
Provide feedback about the assistance received.
how_to_submit: Use the feedback facility provided by the official PDS portal when available.
Use the official grievance or support mechanism when the feedback concerns a specific unresolved problem.
Contact the concerned State/UT Food and Civil Supplies authority through its official channels.
information_to_include: A clear description of the feedback.
Relevant service or transaction details when applicable.
Application, transaction or complaint reference information when applicable.
facts.state_specific: The available feedback facilities and submission procedures can differ between States and Union Territories.
privacy: Submit feedback only through official government channels.
Do not include unnecessary personal information.
Do not share OTPs, passwords or other authentication credentials.
important_notes: Do not invent a specific feedback URL, email address or phone number.
A State or Union Territory should be identified before providing State-specific feedback channels.
A feedback submission is different from an urgent grievance or complaint requiring administrative action.

faqs.question: How can I give feedback about PDS services?
faqs.answer: Use the feedback facility provided by the official PDS portal or contact the concerned State/UT Food and Civil Supplies authority through its official channels.

faqs.question: Can I give feedback about the PDS portal?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the applicable portal provides a feedback facility, you can use it to report your experience or suggest improvements.

faqs.question: Where can I submit PDS feedback?
faqs.answer: The available feedback channel depends on the concerned State or Union Territory. Use its official PDS portal, support or feedback mechanism.

faqs.question: Can I give feedback about ration distribution?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can provide feedback through the applicable official PDS feedback or support mechanism.

faqs.question: What should I include in my feedback?
faqs.answer: Provide a clear description of your experience or suggestion and relevant service, transaction or complaint details when applicable.

faqs.question: Is feedback the same as a complaint?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Feedback can include general experiences or suggestions, while a complaint or grievance is generally used to report a specific problem requiring attention.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
Concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies Authority
